items.title: Hanoi authorities bust counterfeit Louis Vuitton and Gucci workshop behind storefront
items.summary: Vietnamese market-management police dismantled a counterfeit luxury goods operation in Hanoi's Kim Lien Ward, seizing 19 fake Louis Vuitton items and 5 fake Gucci items (handbags, wallets, belts priced 2-10 million VND each). A linked manufacturing workshop in Thanh Liet Ward was also raided. Since 2022 the ring allegedly earned roughly 4.2 billion VND illegally, with about 714 million VND from 129 counterfeit items produced in 2026 alone. Case remains under investigation for trademark infringement.
